decisions.reason: This door lever handle family remains close to the established offer and its results meet the aspiration formed from the firm's own handle lines and comparable German firms, so no problemistic search is triggered.
The door handle design is close to existing products and appears to perform at or above the aspiration level, so the firm retains it rather than searching for alternative uses of the resources.

The electronic access system is close to the firm's established electronic access competence and shows continued website emphasis; given organisational slack, the firm keeps it while monitoring the remaining uncertainty.
